prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 43 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a reported impact to the vehicle that is consistent in type and force with the neck and back strain described. Diagnosis is cervical and lumbar strain. Cervical and lumbar imaging and the standard neurological and orthopedic examinations were within normal limits. Nearly all reported findings rest on the patient's own descriptions of pain and limited motion. No prior injury or treatment to the same areas is known from history or records. Care has been intensive, totaling 43 visits, most occurring near-daily, and pain complaints were extended to additional body regions several weeks after the collision. Billing records do not show repeated charges for the same services. Given the mechanism and the normal objective testing, continued care should be reviewed against accepted treatment guidelines for soft tissue injury, with attention to the frequency of visits and the basis for the newer complaints.
